title: Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: A delicious and flavorful dish from Greece, featuring lamb kebabs baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the lamb, onion, bell pepper, and zucchini onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
